metadata.doc: Package indexes for every project, searched after the project's own
Toolchains for every project. A project's toolchain of the same name wins
Seconds to wait to connect to a server, and for a stalled transfer to make progress, before giving up. It must be at least `1`; values above `65535` are treated as `65535`
Path to a PEM file of trusted root certificates
Clone and fetch every index and Git dependency with the `git` on your `PATH`, not only the ones that need your credentials
Size in GiB the build cache may reach before `spn` evicts from it. `0` means no limit, and nothing is evicted automatically
Seconds an entry is kept after its last use, whatever the size of the cache. Values below `600` are treated as `600`
Seconds between checks of the size of the cache
